events.title: Demo v0.8.1 Update
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here, and the demo has a new update for it. Your save carries over. New shearing music The shed now plays "Knees Up" by Breabach, a Scottish folk band, while you shear. More new tracks on the way for the full release 🎧. Between sheep the music settles down rather than stopping, and when you come back to shear it picks up where it left off. events.title: Sheepscape - Demo v0.6.2 Update
events.summary: The demo is now playable in nine more languages: Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Polish and Ukrainian. These are all of the languages I'm planning to launch with on 5 November. Your save carries over. Languages The game starts in your Steam language, or your computer's, if it's one of the ten. events.title: Sheepscape - Demo v0.6.1 Update
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has played the demo so far, filled in the feedback form, or made a video ❤️. There were some common themes: the wait between shears was boring, sheep got stuck in corners, the first shears were slow and punishing, and nobody could find how to sell a sheep. This update is about all of that. There's quite a bit in this one 😅. Your save carries over. The smallholding has grown a border, and your flock, your money and your progress are all kept. events.title: The free demo is out now 🐑
events.summary: The free Sheepscape demo is out now on Steam. You start with five muddy sheep on a Welsh smallholding and one dog, and you've got about an hour to build them into a flock good enough to buy your next farm. Play the free demo If you played the Playtest or sent feedback since 0.3.6: thank you 🙏. This is the biggest update yet, and it's the build the demo launches with. events.title: Sheepscape - Playtest v0.3.6 Patch
events.summary: Thank you for everything you've sent in over the playtest period ❤️. One message came through louder than the rest: being able to see the pressure is what made herding click. So this update keeps the radar for good, and carries on making the numbers on your sheep make sense. The pressure radar stays on The red circle 🔴 around the farmer and your dog used to switch itself off after your first couple of round-ups. events.title: The first playable Sheepscape playtest is open 🐑
events.summary: Sheepscape has reached the point I have been building toward since I started five months ago: a version you can play from the first sheep to the day you buy your second farm. It has the whole year in it: lambing, shearing, a market and a winter that will take sheep off you if you're not paying attention.
